tooltip.trackingNumber: Unique identifier for the package. This is the primary key used to track the shipment throughout the system.
tooltip.weight: Package weight in kilograms or pounds. Used for shipping cost calculations and carrier requirements.
tooltip.description: Brief description of the package contents. Helps identify the shipment and is required for customs documentation.
tooltip.guideId: Manifest guide number or airway bill (AWB). Links this package to the carrier's manifest for tracking.
tooltip.manifestNumber: Manifest identifier number. Used to group packages from the same shipment or import batch.
tooltip.customerName: Name of the customer or recipient. Used to match packages with existing customer records in the system.
tooltip.origin: Origin location or city where the package was shipped from. Helps with route planning and tracking.
tooltip.destination: Destination location or city where the package will be delivered. Used for route assignment and delivery planning.
tooltip.customerId: SL Account Code of the customer. Allows direct linking to an existing customer record.
tooltip.type: Shipment type (Air, Sea, Freight, Local). Determines handling procedures and delivery timelines.
tooltip.status: Current status of the package. Defaults to 'pending' if not specified.
